Se hai l'epidurale o ti è stato indotto: If you have an epidural or your labour has been induced
Le posizioni le decide il team. Spesso s: The team decides the positions. Lying on your side often helps. The app gives no guided exercises.
Segui il tuo stimolo, nel modo che ti vi: Follow your urge, in the way that comes naturally, and your midwife's guidance. There is no single right way to push.
Spinta spontanea o guidata: nessuna diff: Spontaneous or directed pushing: no clear difference in duration and tears. With an epidural, pushing straight away or later does not change the percentage of spontaneous vaginal births (JAMA 2018 study). Pressure on the top of the uterus is not recommended.
Puoi chiedere una posizione eretta, in g: You can ask for an upright, kneeling, side-lying or squatting position.
Le posizioni erette si associano a meno: Upright positions are associated with fewer assisted births and fewer episiotomies, but possibly with more second-degree tears and more blood loss (over 500 ml): there are benefits and risks, and the choice is yours and the team's (Cochrane 2017).
Dalla 34ª-35ª settimana puoi chiedere al: From week 34-35 you can ask your midwife how to do perineal massage. During pushing you can ask whether she uses warm compresses or massage.
Respiro, rilassamento e una persona acca: Breathing, relaxation and a person beside you
Il respiro lento e il rilassamento sono: Slow breathing and relaxation are comfort tools. Choose and prepare a support person.
Rilassamento e respiro hanno prove di ba: Relaxation and breathing have low-certainty evidence for pain and should not be presented as methods to shorten labour. Continuous support in labour has the strongest evidence: more spontaneous vaginal births, fewer caesareans and less analgesia.
Solo se il tuo punto nascita la offre e: Only if your maternity unit offers it and you are low risk
L'immersione in acqua nel primo stadio p: Immersion in water during the first stage may slightly reduce the use of an epidural.
15 studi su donne sane, a basso rischio: 15 studies in healthy, low-risk women at term: no evidence of harm, but for the pushing stage the data are few.
In sala parto le indicazioni su posizion: In the delivery room, the guidance on positions, pushing and water is the same for everyone, whatever your fitness level: the studies do not justify different advice. Fitness matters earlier, in how you prepare during pregnancy.
Allenarsi in gravidanza è associato a me: Exercising in pregnancy is associated with fewer instrumental births (about 24% fewer, moderate certainty). On caesarean section and on the length of labour the meta-analyses disagree, and there is no relationship between the amount of exercise and outcomes: we cannot promise that training will shorten labour.
Nelle atlete di alto livello non ci sono: In elite athletes there are no differences in the main birth outcomes compared with active or sedentary women.
Le linee guida dicono che chi era attiva: The guidelines say that if you were active you can continue, and if you were not you should start gradually, with at least 150 minutes a week of moderate activity if there are no contraindications, plus pelvic floor work.
Un pavimento pelvico forte non rende il: A strong pelvic floor does not make birth harder: exercises in pregnancy reduce incontinence (62% less at the end of pregnancy in women who were continent) and are not found to lengthen labour.

Respirazione, pavimento pelvico ogni gio: Breathing, pelvic floor every day, short walks and gentle movements. No running, jumping, heavy lifting or intense abdominal exercises.
Dopo il controllo post-parto: camminata: After the postnatal check: brisk walking or stationary cycling, progressive pelvic floor work, light strength for glutes, back and arms, gradual core work.
Corsa con alternanza cammina-corri e for: Run-walk intervals and progressive strength, only if there are no pelvic symptoms and you pass the loading tests.

I programmi di prevenzione neuromuscolar: Neuromuscular prevention programmes halve the risk of anterior cruciate ligament injury (OR 0.50); for males the data are not enough.

Gli esercizi del pavimento pelvico dopo: Pelvic floor exercises after birth reduce urinary incontinence (2025 meta-analysis: 37% lower, moderate certainty); the 2020 Cochrane review is more uncertain for exercises started after birth. Supervised programmes are needed, with contractions close to maximum and lasting at least 8 weeks.

With an epidural, guided in-bed activities shortened labour, while upright activity alone increased operative vaginal births by 8%.
